questions.prompt: State what is meant by (a) amplitude and (b) wavelength.
A pulse travels along a rope and makes a bead at the far end move. Which statement describes the transfer?

options.A: The rope material travels with the pulse to the bead.
options.B: Energy travels with the disturbance while rope sections move locally.
options.C: Only matter is transferred because the bead moves.
options.D: Neither energy nor a disturbance reaches the bead.

questions.prompt: A point on a wave moves between displacements +4.0 mm and -4.0 mm. What is its amplitude?
Two points on a wave have the same displacement but one is moving upward and the other downward. Which conclusion is valid?

options.A: They must be in phase because their displacements are equal.
options.B: They are not in phase because their directions of motion differ.
options.C: They must be one wavelength apart.
